intro: 引入复阻抗 Z 和复导纳 Y 之后，正弦稳态电路就“长得像”电阻电路。
串并联、分压分流、结点法、网孔法、叠加、戴维宁都可以照搬。只是所有量都换成相量，电阻换成复阻抗。
难点在复数运算和相量图。
With impedance Z and admittance Y, a sinusoidal steady-state circuit “looks like” a resistive one.
Series and parallel, dividers, nodal and mesh analysis, superposition and Thévenin all carry over. Every quantity just becomes a phasor, and every resistance an impedance.
The difficulty is in the complex arithmetic and the phasor diagrams.

ideas.title: 复阻抗 Z 与电路的性质
text: - 无源二端网络端口的电压相量与电流相量之比（关联参考方向）叫**复阻抗**：Z = V̇/İ = R + jX = |Z|∠φ_Z。
- |Z| = V/I。阻抗角 φ_Z = ψ_v − ψ_i，就是电压超前电流的角度。
- R、L、C 的阻抗分别是 R、jωL、−j/(ωC)。RLC 串联：Z = R + j(ωL − \frac{1}{ωC})。
- X > 0（φ_Z > 0）电路呈**感性**，电压超前电流。X < 0 呈**容性**，电压滞后电流。X = 0 呈**电阻性**，电压、电流同相。
- 串联电路里，分电压可以大于总电压，因为 L、C 的电压会部分抵消。面包板 4.2 的串联谐振里见过：电容上的电压比加上去的电压还大。

en.title: Impedance Z and the character of a circuit
text: - The ratio of the port voltage phasor to the current phasor of a passive one-port (passive sign convention) is its **impedance**: Z = V̇/İ = R + jX = |Z|∠φ_Z.
- |Z| = V/I. The impedance angle φ_Z = ψ_v − ψ_i is the angle by which the voltage leads the current.
- The impedances of R, L and C are R, jωL and −j/(ωC). Series RLC: Z = R + j(ωL − \frac{1}{ωC}).
- X > 0 (φ_Z > 0): **inductive**, the voltage leads the current. X < 0: **capacitive**, the voltage lags. X = 0: **resistive**, voltage and current in phase.

- In a series circuit a part voltage can exceed the total, because the L and C voltages partly cancel. You saw it in the series resonance lab on the breadboard (4.2): the capacitor voltage was larger than the applied voltage.

ideas.title: 复导纳 Y 与并联电路
text: - Y = 1/Z = İ/V̇ = G + jB。
- R、L、C 的导纳是 1/R、−j/(ωL)、jωC。RLC 并联：Y = G + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL})。
- **B > 0 呈容性**（电流超前电压），B < 0 呈感性。符号规律和 X 相反，最稳妥的是直接看电流超前还是滞后。
- 注意：Z = R + jX 时，Y 的实部 G = R/(R² + X²)，不是 1/R。
- 并联电路适合用导纳（导纳相加），串联电路适合用阻抗。

en.title: Admittance Y and parallel circuits
text: - Y = 1/Z = İ/V̇ = G + jB.
- The admittances of R, L and C are 1/R, −j/(ωL) and jωC. Parallel RLC: Y = G + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL}).
- **B > 0 is capacitive** (current leads voltage) and B < 0 inductive. The sign rule is the opposite of X's, so it is safest to ask whether the current leads or lags.
- Careful: for Z = R + jX the real part of Y is G = R/(R² + X²), not 1/R.
- Use admittances for parallel circuits (they add) and impedances for series circuits.

ideas.title: 阻抗的串并联、分压与分流
text: - 串联 Z = Z_1 + Z_2 + …。并联 Y = Y_1 + Y_2 + …；两个阻抗并联时 Z = \frac{Z_1Z_2}{Z_1 + Z_2}。
- 分压 V̇_k = \frac{Z_k}{Z}V̇，分流 İ_k = \frac{Y_k}{Y}İ。形式和电阻电路完全一样，只是都要做复数运算。
- 阻抗随频率变化：同一个网络在某个频率下可以是纯电阻性的，换一个频率就不是了。

en.title: Series and parallel impedances, dividers
text: - Series Z = Z_1 + Z_2 + …. Parallel Y = Y_1 + Y_2 + …; two impedances in parallel give Z = \frac{Z_1Z_2}{Z_1 + Z_2}.
- Voltage divider V̇_k = \frac{Z_k}{Z}V̇, current divider İ_k = \frac{Y_k}{Y}İ. The forms are exactly those for resistors; only the arithmetic is complex.
- Impedance depends on frequency: a network can be purely resistive at one frequency and not at another.

ideas.title: 相量法的步骤
text: 1. 把激励写成相量（先化成 cos），元件换成复阻抗，画出相量模型。
2. 用电阻电路的任何一种方法，求出所要的相量。
3. 把结果写回时域：İ = I∠ψ_i ↔ i(t) = √2I cos(ωt + ψ_i)（有效值相量）。
相量法只给出**稳态**响应，而且要求全电路是同一个频率。

en.title: The phasor method, step by step
text: 1. Write the sources as phasors (convert to cosine first), replace the elements by impedances and draw the phasor model.
2. Find the phasors you need with any resistive-circuit method.
3. Convert back to the time domain: İ = I∠ψ_i ↔ i(t) = √2I cos(ωt + ψ_i) (rms phasors).
The phasor method gives only the **steady-state** response, and the whole circuit must run at one frequency.

ideas.title: 相量图辅助求解：三表法与同相条件
text: - 只给有效值（电表读数）时，画相量图。串联部分以电流为参考，并联部分以电压为参考。
- R 上的电压与电流同向；L、C 上的电压与电流垂直。
- **三电压表法**：V̇ = V̇_1 + V̇_2，三个读数就是三角形的三条边。
- 用余弦定理求出线圈电压与电流的夹角，再得到 r、X_L。
- “端口电压与电流同相”说明整体呈纯电阻性，总阻抗的虚部为零。
- 它在相量图上给出一个直角或一个已知的角度，往往就是解题的关键条件。

en.title: Solving with phasor diagrams: three-meter methods, in-phase conditions
text: - When only rms values (meter readings) are given, draw a phasor diagram. Take the current as reference for a series part and the voltage for a parallel part.
- The voltage of R is along its current; those of L and C are perpendicular to theirs.
- **Three-voltmeter method**: V̇ = V̇_1 + V̇_2, so the three readings are the three sides of a triangle.
- The law of cosines gives the angle between the coil voltage and the current, and from it r and X_L.
- “Port voltage in phase with the current” means the whole is purely resistive: the total impedance has zero imaginary part.
- On the diagram this fixes a right angle or another known angle, which is often the key condition.

ideas.title: 结点电压法、网孔电流法（相量形式）
text: - 方程的列法和电阻电路相同：电导换成复导纳，电阻换成复阻抗。
- 结点法：自导纳 × 本结点电压 − 互导纳 × 相邻结点电压 = 流入的电源电流。
- 网孔法：自阻抗 × 本网孔电流 ± 互阻抗 × 相邻网孔电流 = 电压源的电压升。
- 与电流源串联的元件不进入结点方程。它不影响结点电压，只影响电流源两端的电压。
- 有受控源时，先把它当独立源列方程，再补一个控制量方程。
- 复数方程组常用代入消元来解。算完，用一个没用过的 KCL 或 KVL 验算。

en.title: Nodal and mesh analysis with phasors
text: - The equations are written exactly as for resistive circuits, with admittances for conductances and impedances for resistances.
- Nodal: self-admittance × own node voltage − mutual admittance × neighbouring node voltage = source current flowing in.
- Mesh: self-impedance × own mesh current ± mutual impedance × neighbouring mesh current = source voltage rise.
- An element in series with a current source does not enter the nodal equations. It changes no node voltage, only the voltage across the current source.
- With a dependent source, first treat it as independent, then add an equation for the controlling quantity.
- Solve the complex system by substitution. Then check with a KCL or KVL equation you have not used.

ideas.title: 叠加定理与戴维宁定理
text: - **叠加**：把各电源单独作用时得到的**相量**相加。电压源置零是短路，电流源置零是开路，受控源保留。
- 只有同一频率的分量才能按相量相加；不同频率的分量只能在时域相加。
- 两个分量的模之和，一般不等于合成量的模。
- **戴维宁**：V̇_oc 是端口开路电压，Z_eq 是独立源置零后的入端阻抗，也等于 V̇_oc/İ_sc。
- 有受控源时，受控源不能置零。用**外加电源法**（端口加 İ 求 V̇，或加 V̇ 求 İ），或者开路电压 / 短路电流法求 Z_eq。

en.title: Superposition and Thévenin's theorem
text: - **Superposition**: add the **phasors** produced by each source acting alone. A zeroed voltage source is a short, a zeroed current source an open; dependent sources stay.
- Only components of the same frequency may be added as phasors; components of different frequencies are added in the time domain.
- The magnitudes of the parts generally do not add up to the magnitude of the total.
- **Thévenin**: V̇_oc is the open-circuit port voltage and Z_eq the input impedance with independent sources zeroed; also Z_eq = V̇_oc/İ_sc.
- Never zero a dependent source. Find Z_eq with a **test source** (apply İ and find V̇, or the other way round) or by the open-circuit / short-circuit method.

ideas.title: 含理想运放的正弦稳态电路
text: - 虚短（V̇_{+} = V̇_{−}）和虚断（输入电流为零）对相量同样成立。在输入端结点列 KCL 即可。
- 反相放大器的电阻换成阻抗：V̇_o = −\frac{Z_f}{Z_1}V̇_i。
- 增益的模和相位都随频率变化，这就是有源滤波器。面包板 4.3 的有源低通正是 R_f 旁并一个电容：在截止频率处，输出相对输入的相位差是 +135°，即反相的 180° 再落后 45°。

en.title: Ideal op-amps in sinusoidal steady state
text: - Virtual short (V̇_{+} = V̇_{−}) and virtual open (no input current) hold for phasors too. Write KCL at the input nodes.
- The inverting amplifier with impedances: V̇_o = −\frac{Z_f}{Z_1}V̇_i.

- Both the magnitude and the phase of the gain vary with frequency: that is an active filter. The active low-pass on the breadboard (4.3) is exactly this, with a capacitor across R_f. At the cutoff frequency the output is +135° from the input: the 180° inversion, then 45° behind.

ideas.title: 交流电桥的平衡
text: - 四臂阻抗为 Z_1、Z_x、Z_3、Z_4 的电桥，检流计电流为零的条件是**对边阻抗乘积相等**：Z_1Z_4 = Z_3Z_x。
- 这是一个复数等式，相当于两个实数条件：实部、虚部各一个（或者模、辐角各一个）。
- 所以交流电桥一般要调两个元件才能平衡；也正好能测出未知线圈的两个参数 R_x 和 L_x。

en.title: Balancing an AC bridge
text: - For a bridge with arm impedances Z_1, Z_x, Z_3, Z_4, the detector current is zero when **the products of opposite arms are equal**: Z_1Z_4 = Z_3Z_x.
- This is one complex equation, i.e. two real conditions: one for the real part and one for the imaginary part (or magnitude and angle).
- So an AC bridge usually needs two adjustments to balance, and it yields exactly two unknowns of a coil, R_x and L_x.

formulas.name: 复阻抗
formulas.when: 无源二端网络，端口 v、i 关联参考方向；φ_Z > 0 感性，< 0 容性。

en.name: Impedance
en.expr: Z = \frac{V̇}{İ} = R + jX = |Z|∠φ_Z, |Z| = \frac{V}{I}, φ_Z = ψ_v − ψ_i
en.when: Passive one-port, port v and i associated; φ_Z > 0 inductive, < 0 capacitive.

formulas.name: RLC 串联
formulas.when: R、L、C 串联，给定 ω；X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC) 都取正值。

en.name: Series RLC
en.when: R, L, C in series at a given ω; X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC) are positive.

formulas.name: 复导纳
formulas.expr: Y = \frac{1}{Z} = G + jB；RLC 并联 Y = \frac{1}{R} + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL})
formulas.when: v、i 关联；B > 0 容性，B < 0 感性。Z = R + jX 时 G = R/(R² + X²)。

en.name: Admittance
en.expr: Y = \frac{1}{Z} = G + jB; parallel RLC Y = \frac{1}{R} + j(ωC − \frac{1}{ωL})
en.when: v and i associated; B > 0 capacitive, B < 0 inductive. For Z = R + jX, G = R/(R² + X²).

formulas.name: 串并联与分压
formulas.expr: Z_{串} = ΣZ_k，Y_{并} = ΣY_k，Z_1 ∥ Z_2 = \frac{Z_1Z_2}{Z_1 + Z_2}，V̇_k = \frac{Z_k}{ΣZ}V̇
formulas.when: 同一频率；分压公式只用于串联（同一电流）的阻抗。

en.name: Series, parallel, divider
en.expr: Z_{series} = ΣZ_k, Y_{parallel} = ΣY_k, Z_1 ∥ Z_2 = \frac{Z_1Z_2}{Z_1 + Z_2}, V̇_k = \frac{Z_k}{ΣZ}V̇
en.when: One frequency; the divider applies only to impedances in series (same current).

formulas.name: 三电压表法（余弦定理）
formulas.when: V̇ = V̇_1 + V̇_2，V̇_1 为已知电阻电压（与 İ 同相），φ_2 为线圈电压超前电流的角度。

en.name: Three-voltmeter method (law of cosines)
en.when: V̇ = V̇_1 + V̇_2 with V̇_1 across the known resistor (in phase with İ); φ_2 is the angle by which the coil voltage leads the current.

formulas.name: 弥尔曼定理（两结点）
formulas.when: 只有一个独立结点 a，另一个结点是参考点。V̇_{sk} 是与 Y_k 串联的电压源，“+”朝 a 时取正。İ_s 是注入 a 的电流源。与电流源串联的元件不计入 ΣY_k。

en.name: Millman's theorem (two nodes)
en.when: One independent node a; the other node is the reference. V̇_{sk} is the voltage source in series with Y_k, positive with “+” towards a. İ_s are the current sources into a. Elements in series with a current source are left out of ΣY_k.

formulas.name: 戴维宁等效
formulas.when: 线性网络，同一频率。İ 从等效电路的“+”端流出。求 Z_eq：独立源置零（受控源保留），或用外加电源法。

en.name: Thévenin equivalent
en.when: Linear network, one frequency. İ leaves the “+” terminal of the equivalent. Find Z_eq with independent sources zeroed (dependent ones kept) or with a test source.

formulas.name: 反相放大器
formulas.when: 理想运放工作在线性区（虚短、虚断），同相输入端接地。

en.name: Inverting amplifier
en.when: Ideal op-amp in its linear region (virtual short, virtual open), non-inverting input grounded.

formulas.name: 电桥平衡
formulas.when: 检流计接在两条分压支路的中点之间。Z_1 与 Z_x 是一条支路，Z_3 与 Z_4 是另一条；对边相乘。实部、虚部要同时相等。

en.name: Bridge balance
en.when: Detector between the midpoints of the two divider branches. Z_1 with Z_x form one branch, Z_3 with Z_4 the other; multiply opposite arms. Real and imaginary parts must both be equal.

examples.title: 正弦稳态戴维宁等效与负载电流
examples.statement: 图示电路中 V̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R_1 = 5 Ω，C = 200 µF。a、b 端接负载：R_L = 2.5 Ω 与 L = 2.5 mH 串联。求 a、b 以左电路的戴维宁等效电路，再求负载电流 İ_L。
steps: 3. **等效阻抗。** V_s 置零（短路），从 a、b 看进去是 R_1 ∥ Z_C：Z_eq = \frac{5 × (−j5)}{5 − j5} = **2.5 − j2.5 Ω**（容性）。
5. **说明。** 负载电抗 +j2.5 恰好抵消了 Z_eq 的 −j2.5，回路总阻抗是纯电阻——下一章会看到，这正是负载获得最大功率的共轭匹配条件。

en.title: Thévenin equivalent in AC steady state and the load current
en.statement: V̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R_1 = 5 Ω, C = 200 µF. The load across a, b is R_L = 2.5 Ω in series with L = 2.5 mH. Find the Thévenin equivalent of the circuit to the left of a, b, then the load current İ_L.
steps: 1. **Impedances.** Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j/(1000 × 200×10⁻⁶) = −j5 Ω; load Z_L = R_L + jωL = 2.5 + j2.5 Ω.
2. **Open-circuit voltage (divider).** Remove the load; R_1 and C divide the source: V̇_oc = V̇_s·\frac{−j5}{5 − j5} = 10 × \frac{−j}{1 − j} = 5 − j5 V, i.e. **V_oc = 7.071 V** at **−45°**.
3. **Equivalent impedance.** Zero V_s (short); looking into a, b we see R_1 ∥ Z_C: Z_eq = \frac{5 × (−j5)}{5 − j5} = **2.5 − j2.5 Ω** (capacitive).

5. **Note.** The load reactance +j2.5 cancels the −j2.5 of Z_eq, so the loop impedance is purely resistive — the next chapter shows this is exactly the conjugate-matching condition for maximum power to the load.

examples.title: 两个电源的结点电压（弥尔曼定理）
examples.statement: 图示电路中 ω = 1000 rad/s，V̇_s1 = 10∠0° V，V̇_s2 = 10∠90° V（有效值），R = 5 Ω，L = 5 mH，C = 100 µF。用结点电压法求结点 a 的电压 V̇_a 和电容电流 İ_C，并写出 v_a(t)。

en.title: Node voltage with two sources (Millman)
en.statement: ω = 1000 rad/s, V̇_s1 = 10∠0° V, V̇_s2 = 10∠90° V (rms), R = 5 Ω, L = 5 mH, C = 100 µF. Use nodal analysis to find the voltage V̇_a of node a and the capacitor current İ_C, and write v_a(t).
steps: 2. **Nodal equation.** Only one independent node, a: (0.2 + j0.1 − j0.2)V̇_a = 0.2V̇_s1 + \frac{V̇_s2}{j5} = 2 + \frac{j10}{j5} = 4.
3. **Solve.** V̇_a = \frac{4}{0.2 − j0.1} = \frac{4(0.2 + j0.1)}{0.05} = **16 + j8 V**, i.e. **V_a = 17.89 V** at **26.57°** — larger than either source, a result of the partial resonance of L and C.
4. **Capacitor current.** İ_C = jωC·V̇_a = j0.1(16 + j8) = −0.8 + j1.6 A, **I_C = 1.789 A** at **116.57°** (leading V̇_a by 90°).
5. **Back to the time domain.** v_a(t) = 17.89√2 cos(1000t + 26.57°) V.
6. **Check (KCL).** Current in R: (10 − 16 − j8)/5 = −1.2 − j1.6; in L: (j10 − 16 − j8)/(j5) = 0.4 + j3.2; both flow into a and add to −0.8 + j1.6 = İ_C ✓.

mistakes.text: 把阻抗的模直接相加：|Z_1 + Z_2| ≠ |Z_1| + |Z_2|。串联时实部、虚部分别相加，再求模。

en.text: Adding impedance magnitudes: |Z_1 + Z_2| ≠ |Z_1| + |Z_2|. In series add real and imaginary parts separately, then take the magnitude.

mistakes.text: 由 Z = R + jX 写 Y = 1/R + j/X。必须做复数除法：Y = \frac{R − jX}{R^{2} + X^{2}}。

en.text: Writing Y = 1/R + j/X for Z = R + jX. Do the complex division: Y = \frac{R − jX}{R^{2} + X^{2}}.

mistakes.text: 感性/容性判据记混：阻抗 X > 0 感性，导纳 B > 0 却是容性。拿不准时看电流超前（容性）还是滞后（感性）电压。

en.text: Mixing up the sign rules: X > 0 in an impedance is inductive, but B > 0 in an admittance is capacitive. When unsure, ask whether the current leads (capacitive) or lags (inductive) the voltage.

mistakes.text: 不同频率的电源单独作用的结果直接按相量相加。不同频率的分量只能写成时域表达式后相加，有效值按 √(V_1² + V_2²) 合成。

en.text: Adding phasors from sources of different frequencies. Such components can only be added as time functions; their rms values combine as √(V_1² + V_2²).

mistakes.text: 求 Z_eq 时把受控源也置零。受控源要保留，用外加电源法或 V̇_oc/İ_sc 求。

en.text: Zeroing dependent sources when finding Z_eq. Keep them; use a test source or V̇_oc/İ_sc.

mistakes.text: 把与电流源串联的阻抗写进结点方程的自导纳。它不影响任何结点电压（只影响电流源两端电压），列结点方程时要去掉。

en.text: Including an impedance in series with a current source in a self-admittance. It affects no node voltage (only the voltage across the current source) and must be left out of the nodal equations.
